scope: 6-10월 구조별 마스터 패턴의 기존 '확인 필요' 19칸 전수 재검증. 월별 급등 뉴스 보드와 기존 복기 표본을 재검토하고 SEC 원문으로 핵심 구조를 교차검증.
evidenceNotes: ATLN: 2026-06-23 Circle8 Dutch Vehicle Authority 4-year framework agreement, minimum ~$52M.

CHPT: 2026-09-03 earnings move +74.95% with 134.6x relative volume on the reviewed board; treated as a non-pure-microcap auxiliary sample.

methodNotes: '해당 사례 없음' means no representative case satisfying the card definition was confirmed in the current review universe; it is not a claim that no such security existed anywhere in the market.
Historical Short Interest/CTB/Borrow snapshots were not used as sole classification evidence when a reliable contemporaneous snapshot could not be reconstructed.
Information published after the move is separated from pre-move discoverability and used only to verify follow-on dilution/outcome.
